sections.heading: tyFaceFractureModifier
sections.content:
ThetyFaceFracturemodifier allows you to fracture mesh faces into separate mesh elements.

The functionality of this modifier is equivalent to the functionality oftyFlow’sFace Fracture operator.

sections.heading: Operate On
sections.content:
Triangles: triangles will be treated as single faces.Polygons: polygons (adjacent triangles that share a hidden edge) will be treated as single faces.Material IDs: faces will be split up by shared adjacent material IDs.Smoothing Groups: faces will be split up by shared adjacent smoothing groups.Preserve normals: when enabled, existing surface normals will be made explicit and preserved during the operation.

Triangles: triangles will be treated as single faces.

Polygons: polygons (adjacent triangles that share a hidden edge) will be treated as single faces.

Material IDs: faces will be split up by shared adjacent material IDs.

Smoothing Groups: faces will be split up by shared adjacent smoothing groups.

Preserve normals: when enabled, existing surface normals will be made explicit and preserved during the operation.

sections.heading: Max faces per fracture
sections.content:
Faces: the number of faces per fracture group.

Random fracture order: when enabled, faces will be extracted in a random order. This increases the irregularity of extracted shapes.

sections.heading: Face area constraints
sections.content:
Min/Max: the target min/max combined face area per fracture group.Variation %: the per-particle percentage of variation to apply.

Min/Max: the target min/max combined face area per fracture group.

sections.heading: Uniqueness
sections.content: Seed: the seed value for all varied parameters.
